# CANDIDATE: OR_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A downside volume imbalance inside the opening range predicts a break below the OR low with follow‑through selling. The edge exists because aggressive selling pressure early in the session, reflected in higher downtick volume, often precedes a breakdown of the opening range low, especially in low-volatility, tight-range conditions where stop runs are more likely to trigger cascading liquidation.

## Mechanism

Define opening range (OR) as high/low of first 5‑minute bar (09:30‑09:35 ET). Within that bar, calculate uptick volume (volume on bars where close > open) and downtick volume (volume where close < open). If downtick volume / (uptick volume + downtick volume) > 0.62 (i.e., >62% downside volume) and price is within the upper half of the OR (close > (OR high + OR low)/2), then enter short on the first bar that breaks below the OR low with close < OR low. Exit: Stop placed at OR high + $0.05 buffer, target at 1.5× risk or trail using chandelier exit (ATR×3) if price moves favorably. Regime filters: Only trade when VIX < 18 and OR width < 0.3% of SPY; avoid when VIX > 22 or OR width > 0.6%.
